findings.title: R-10 fix regression: replay.sh deletes the operator's export/, inputs/, register.sql (any OWN_OUTPUTS name) from a pre-existing NON-EMPTY --out directory on every refusal raised before makedirs, including out_dir_not_empty itself
findings.evidence: Scratch root with stub BACKUP; --out dir pre-populated with export/report.csv, inputs/, register.sql, notes.txt. Fixed replay.sh: 'REFUSED reason=out_dir_not_empty' rc=20, afterwards only notes.txt remains (export/, inputs/, register.sql deleted). Same with an early journal_row_incomplete refusal (register.sql deleted). HEAD replay.sh on the same input: rc=20, every file kept. Cause: refuse() now deletes OWN_OUTPUTS whenever created is False and OUT is a dir, but every refusal before os.makedirs (since_malformed, journal_*, replay_pending_ops, since_not_found, out_dir_not_empty) runs with created False in a directory this run wrote nothing into. The refusal text even says 'nothing was written'. Tests R10-1..4 only use a pre-existing EMPTY directory.
findings.violates: constitution 9 / 9.2 (zero-risk data safety), 11.4.252 (fail closed on a destructive side effect), 11.4.276(C) class-exhaustive closure (R-10 class 'remove what this run did not create')
findings.fix: Track the names this run actually created (a set filled at each write), not a static name list; delete only those; no deletion at all before the run's first write. RED tests: non-empty pre-existing dir with a colliding name under out_dir_not_empty and under an early refusal.

findings.title: equivalent_gate_mutants.tsv row prefix_importer_literal_loosened is NOT equivalent: the original gate ignores a non-3-letter --prefix literal in an importer
findings.evidence: Scratch REG_ROOT copy; appended ALT = ["add", "--prefix", "CATS"] to import_tickets.py. Original gate.sh: 'INFO prefix_agreement prefix=CAT sources=4' + GATE OK. The 'equivalent' mutant ([A-Z]*): 'FAIL prefix_agreement: ... holds 2 distinct literal --prefix values' GATE FAILED. The mutant is stricter, so the row is a wrong equivalence claim and the original check is blind to a second, malformed prefix literal (the claimed 'every widened value still differs ... same FAIL' assumes the original would FAIL; it PASSes).
findings.violates: 11.4.201(7) (instrument sees only the 3-letter class), 11.4.194(6)(d) (equivalence asserted without the counter-input)
findings.fix: Extract every --prefix literal of any shape ([^"]*) and require exactly one value that is a 3-letter key; remove the equivalence row; add a fixture with a second literal.

findings.title: A raised sqlite_sequence passes the gate while every future mint is refused (latent DoS invisible to v_ids_malformed)
findings.evidence: Clean 3-item v6 DB, UPDATE sqlite_sequence SET seq=100: gate.sh GATE OK; next INSERT INTO reg_ids refused 'seq must be the next gapless number'. Fail-closed (no wrong id), but the gate reports a register that can no longer mint as healthy.
findings.fix: Add a v_ids_malformed leg: sqlite_sequence.seq for reg_ids <> max(seq) (or IFNULL 0 when empty).

findings.title: Reviewer mutant MA (drop 'OR NEW.seq <> max(seq)' from reg_ids_mint_monotone) survives behaviourally; it is not equivalent
findings.evidence: Legacy gapped register (1,2,3,9): original trigger refuses explicit seq 5; mutant accepts it (ids CAT-001,002,003,005,009).
